from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
import ctypes as C,importlib.util,json,os,sys,struct,time,resource,concurrent.futures
T=Path('/home/qian-qi/.local/state/hia-native-final-custody-20261125');D=T/'verify-program-controls-v1';D.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('client',T/'verify-program-client-v3.py');m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
from tests.test_hia_scalar_profile_native import basic
from hepta.hia_program import verify_program
q=m.Verify();root=q.make(basic());expected=verify_program(basic()).canonical_bytes;rows=[]
policy=m.m.load(T/'verify-program-policy-v3/verify-program.flat','d0ddc82e21460c4003ef3a5a9112f73a4165080311ec73e003440a7f614dc6b4')
FT=C.CFUNCTYPE(C.c_uint32,C.c_void_p,C.c_uint64,C.c_void_p,C.c_uint64,C.c_void_p,C.c_uint64)
lib=C.CDLL(None,use_errno=True);lib.syscall.restype=C.c_long
MASK=(1<<64)-1
def vmsize():
 return int(next(x.split()[1] for x in Path('/proc/self/status').read_text().splitlines() if x.startswith('VmSize:')))*1024
def core(data):
 h=struct.unpack_from('<8s7Q',data);assert h[0]==b'HIAVCF01';return data[64+h[4]:]
class Driver:
 def __init__(self,kind=None,target=None):
  self.kind=kind;self.target=target;self.hits=[];self.effects=0
 def __call__(self,s,sn,o,on,w,wn):
  sa,oa,wa=C.addressof(s),C.addressof(o),C.addressof(w);bases=[0,wa,sa,oa]
  def get(at):return struct.unpack('<Q',C.string_at(oa+at,8))[0]
  def put(at,n):C.memmove(oa+at,struct.pack('<Q',n&MASK),8)
  put(128,0);steps=0
  while True:
   rc=policy(sa,sn,oa,on,wa,wn);steps+=1
   assert steps<1000000,('unexpected runaway',get(128),self.hits)
   if rc==0:return 0
   if rc==10:continue
   self.effects+=1;phase=get(128)
   if rc==8:
    C.memmove(bases[get(16)]+get(24),bases[get(0)]+get(8),get(32));put(1024,0);continue
   assert rc in (1,9),(rc,phase)
   ident=get(0);mask=get(8);args=[get(16+i*8)+bases[(mask>>(i*2))&3]for i in range(6)]
   if rc==1:
    fault=self.kind=='mmap' and ident==9 and phase==self.target and not self.hits
    ca=[C.c_ulonglong(x) for x in args]
    old=resource.getrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS)
    if fault:resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(vmsize(),old[1]))
    try:
     C.set_errno(0);got=lib.syscall(C.c_long(ident),*ca);errno=C.get_errno()
    finally:
     if fault:resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,old)
    if got==-1:got=-errno
    if fault:
     assert got==-12,(phase,got,errno);self.hits.append({'kind':'actual-kernel-ENOMEM','phase':phase,'errno':errno})
   else:
    op=struct.unpack('<Q',C.string_at(args[0]+8,8))[0] if args[1]>=16 else None
    isvalue=ident==m.ptr(q.v.entry);ispayload=ident==m.ptr(q.payload.f)
    selected=(self.kind=='typed' and isvalue and op==6 and phase==112) or (self.kind=='value-drop' and isvalue and op==6 and phase==711 and get(624)==self.target) or (self.kind=='payload-drop' and ispayload and op==3 and phase==711)
    fault=selected and not self.hits
    where=C.addressof(q.v.ctx) if isvalue else C.addressof(q.payload.w)
    old=C.string_at(where,8) if fault else None
    if fault:C.memset(where,0,8)
    try:got=FT(ident)(*args)
    finally:
     if fault:C.memmove(where,old,8)
    if fault:
     actual=struct.unpack('<Q',C.string_at(args[2]+8,8))[0];assert got==0 and actual!=0
     self.hits.append({'kind':'actual-lifecycle-drop-failure','phase':phase,'value_owner':isvalue,'original_status':actual})
   put(1024,got)
def record(name,details):
 rows.append({'case':name,'passed':True,**details});(D/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps({'passed':False,'cases':rows},indent=2)+'\n');print('VERIFY_CONTROL_PASS',name,flush=True)
for kind,target,label in [('typed',None,'typed-cleanup-only-retry'),('value-drop',208,'detached-drop-delayed-success'),('value-drop',160,'input-drop-delayed-success'),('payload-drop',None,'frozen-payload-drop-delayed-success')]:
 fds=set(os.listdir('/proc/self/fd'));drv=Driver(kind,target);h,c,w=q.call(root,entry=drv);assert len(drv.hits)==1 and m.u(h,8)==9 and m.u(h,56)==1 and c==(0,0,0),h.hex()
 retry=Driver();h2,c2,w2=q.call(op=1,w=w,entry=retry);assert m.u(h2,56)==0 and m.u(w.raw,152)==0
 if kind=='typed':assert m.u(h2,8)==9 and c2==(0,0,0)
 else:assert m.u(h2,8)==0 and core(q.take(h2,c2))==expected
 assert set(os.listdir('/proc/self/fd'))==fds
 h3,c3,_=q.call(root);assert m.u(h3,8)==0 and core(q.take(h3,c3))==expected
 record(label,{'faults':drv.hits,'first_effects':drv.effects,'retry_effects':retry.effects})
bad=q.make({'x':1.5});drv=Driver('value-drop',160);h,c,w=q.call(bad,entry=drv);assert m.u(h,8)==9 and m.u(h,56)==1
h,c,_=q.call(op=1,w=w,entry=Driver());err=json.loads(q.take(h,c));assert m.u(h,8)==2 and err['class']=='HIAProgramRejected' and err['message']=='E_HIA_FORMAT: unsupported caller-owned JSON node';record('original-error-payload-preserved-across-drop-retry',{'faults':drv.hits})
for phase in (100,103,41,46,301,400):
 before=set(os.listdir('/proc/self/fd'));drv=Driver('mmap',phase);h,c,w=q.call(root,entry=drv)
 assert len(drv.hits)==1 and m.u(h,8)==5 and m.u(h,56)==0 and c==(0,0,0),(phase,h.hex(),drv.hits)
 assert set(os.listdir('/proc/self/fd'))==before
 h,c,_=q.call(root);assert m.u(h,8)==0 and core(q.take(h,c))==expected
 record('actual-mapping-ENOMEM-'+str(phase),{'faults':drv.hits,'effects':drv.effects})
# Complete unchanged native bridge under an actual whole-call address-space shortage.
w=q.context();s=C.create_string_buffer(128);struct.pack_into('<8s',s,0,b'HIABVFY1');struct.pack_into('<3Q',s,24,*root);o=C.create_string_buffer(262144);before=set(os.listdir('/proc/self/fd'));old=resource.getrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS);limit=vmsize()
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(limit,old[1]))
try:rc=q.entry(s,128,o,len(o),w,len(w))
finally:resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,old)
assert rc==0 and m.u(o.raw,8)==5 and m.u(o.raw,56)==0 and set(os.listdir('/proc/self/fd'))==before
record('complete-native-bridge-real-ENOMEM',{'status':5,'vm_limit_bytes':limit})
# Independent native contexts, shared actual value/payload owners, actual child processes.
raw=q.make(expected);before=set(os.listdir('/proc/self/fd'))
def thread_case(i):
 h,c,_=q.call(root if i%2 else raw);assert m.u(h,8)==0;data=q.take(h,c);assert core(data)==expected;return len(data)
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as pool:sizes=list(pool.map(thread_case,range(32)))
assert set(os.listdir('/proc/self/fd'))==before
record('eight-threads-thirty-two-actual-calls',{'calls':len(sizes),'distinct_contexts':True})
# Immutable result remains owned after every original mutable value is released.
h,c,_=q.call(root);n=m.u(h,40);q.reset_values();data=q.payload.copy(c,0,n);assert core(data)==expected;q.payload.drop(c)
record('result-payload-outlives-all-input-values',{'bytes':n})
q.finish();(D/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps({'passed':True,'groups':len(rows),'cases':rows},indent=2)+'\n');print('VERIFY_CONTROLS_ALL_PASS',len(rows),flush=True)
